entry.title: Honda to invest $3B in new Ohio hybrid vehicle plant
entry.summary: The factory will create 2,000 jobs, and as part of Honda’s focus on hybrids and swift development, it’s keeping close to the automaker’s existing U.S. footprint.

entry.title: Asics boosts inventory management using warehouse drones
entry.summary: By using the technology, the footwear brand improved misplaced inventory recovery while slashing manual labor hours and increasing counting frequency.

entry.title: CarParts.com revs up in-house last-mile delivery for cost, speed benefits
entry.summary: The cost savings opportunity will be “substantial” as the company aims to deliver 300,000 packages a year via its internal network, per CEO David Meniane.

entry.title: Transpacific ocean rates ease slightly as peak winds down
entry.summary: Slowing demand at U.S. ports is helping ease rates, but costs remain elevated on a year-over-year basis.

entry.title: BMW announces new battery supply deals for the US, Europe
entry.summary: The automaker contracted with battery cell manufacturers Samsung SDI and LG Energy Solution as it aims for a more localized supply chain for future electric vehicles.

entry.title: Air cargo’s hopes for end-of-year volume surge dwindle
entry.summary: Market growth remains steady, but pressured capacity and other traditional signals of a late burst in demand were lacking in October, Xeneta reported.

entry.title: Bipartisan push possible to curb Trump tariffs
entry.summary: Three bills in Congress would significantly restrict presidential tariff power if they become law, and experts say there's appetite for change in trade policy.

entry.title: UPS’ Teamsters contract expires in 2028. Shippers should prepare now.
entry.summary: Even with a potential clash a ways out, shippers should ensure they have other established carrier relationships to mitigate strike risk, experts say.

entry.title: Manufacturing advocates make case for tariffs following midterm results
entry.summary: Although polls show the public is tired of import taxes, rolling back trade enforcement would be a “serious mistake,” per an Alliance for American Manufacturing report.

entry.title: Trump threatens to double Mexico tariffs over migrant caravans
entry.summary: The levies would be effective immediately if the country does not halt the movement of caravans into the U.S., the president said.
